notes: Blast Radius edge kind -> MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise technique an attacker would use for that hop. Ordered; the first mapping whose kind and 'when' match wins. 'when' keys (all optional, all must match): sourcePrefix / sourceType / targetType (string or list; types are graph node types) and port (matches when the edge's 'ports' evidence contains it). technique null = no technique (the hop is a correlation, not an attacker action). Names come from data/attack/attack-catalog.json, never from this file. status is 'proposed' until reviewed; 'verified' requires reviewer, reviewedUtc and sourceRef (enforced by tests/Attack.Tests.ps1).
